responsibility: This file implements the frontend `CTFloat` interface for compile-time floating-point evaluation using GCC’s target-aware real-number routines. It provides constant-folding helpers such as absolute value and ldexp, classification predicates for NaN and infinity, parsing of literals in target long-double mode, decimal and hexadecimal formatting, identity comparison, and hashing, so D CTFE uses GCC real semantics rather than host libc behavior.
